description: Python script for summarizing CodexBar local cost usage by model, including functions for data loading, filtering, aggregation, and output formatting.

classes.name: ModelCost
classes.description: Data class representing a model and its associated cost.

methods.name: positive_int
methods.description: Converts a string to a positive integer, raising an error if invalid.

methods.name: eprint
methods.description: Prints a message to standard error.

methods.name: run_codexbar_cost
methods.description: Runs the 'codexbar cost' command and parses its JSON output.

methods.name: load_payload
methods.description: Loads JSON payload from file or runs external command if no input provided.

methods.name: parse_date
methods.description: Parses a date string into a date object.

methods.name: filter_by_days
methods.description: Filters entries to include only those within the specified number of days.

methods.name: aggregate_costs
methods.description: Aggregates costs per model from entries.

methods.name: pick_current_model
methods.description: Selects the most recent or used model from entries.

methods.name: usd
methods.description: Formats a float as USD currency string.

methods.name: latest_day_cost
methods.description: Retrieves the latest day and cost for a specific model.

methods.name: render_text_current
methods.description: Generates a text summary for current model usage.

methods.name: render_text_all
methods.description: Generates a text summary for all models.

methods.name: build_json_current
methods.description: Builds JSON object for current model usage summary.

methods.name: build_json_all
methods.description: Builds JSON object for all models summary.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function to parse arguments and produce output based on model usage data.
